name: Lodestone
summary: A bar magnet call-to-action that leans toward your pointer while thousands of iron filings turn
about: A waitlist button built as a red and blue bar magnet over a field of iron filings drawn on canvas. As your pointer comes near, the magnet is pulled toward it, with the label and poles lagging at their own speeds, and every filing turns to follow the field. Pressing it pulls the filings in, snaps out with a pulse, swirls them round like a spinner, then bursts them out with copper sparks.
how: Move your pointer near the button: it leans toward you and the filings turn to the field, with the pointer bending it too.
Press it (or Tab to it and press Enter or Space): it shrinks and draws the nearby filings in.
It springs back out and a pulse runs through the filings while the label changes to Joining.
The filings circle the magnet like a spinner with a bright head running round.
Done: the filings burst out, copper sparks fly, the core turns mint, the count rolls up and it resets after a moment.
